title: How AI Developed, 1950–2026: Seven Decades in Numbers — Report AI
excerpt: From Turing's 1950 paper to models withheld for their cyber capabilities in 2026: the eras, booms and winters of artificial intelligence, measured in training compute, cost, benchmark scores, money and users.

title: Is AI a Technological Revolution? Carlota Perez's Method, Applied — Report AI
excerpt: Carlota Perez showed that five technological revolutions since 1771 followed the same sequence: a cheap key input, a new infrastructure, a financial frenzy, a crash and then a golden age. We apply her method to AI, test it against the data, and compare her own verdict with the alternatives.

title: AI Development Index: How AI Grew, 1950–2026 — Report AI
excerpt: A year-by-year record of how artificial intelligence developed, in six measures: training compute, capability, cost, capital, adoption and risk. Every value is dated, sourced and confidence-rated, and the full dataset is free to download.
